1.text: Ntugacyahe umukuru ahubwo umuhugure nka so n'abasore ubahugure nka bene so,

2.text: abagore bakuru ubahugure nka ba nyoko, n'abagore bakiri bato n'abakobwa ubahugure nka bashiki bawe, ufite umutima utunganye rwose.

4.text: Ariko umupfakazi niba afite abana cyangwa abuzukuru, babanze kwiga kubaha abo mu muryango wabo no kwitura ababyeyi babo ibibakwiriye, kuko ibyo ari byo bishimwa imbere y'Imana.

5.text: Umupfakazi by'ukuri usigaye wenyine yiringira Imana, akomeza kwinginga no gusenga ku manywa na nijoro,

7.text: Ubategeke ibyo kugira ngo batabaho umugayo.

8.text: Ariko niba umuntu adatunga abe cyane cyane abo mu rugo rwe, aba yihakanye ibyizerwa, kandi aba abaye mubi hanyuma y'utizera.

9.text: Ntihakagire umupfakazi wandikwa, keretse amaze imyaka mirongo itandatu avutse akaba yarashyingiwe umugabo umwe gusa,

10.text: agashimirwa imirimo myiza: niba yarareraga abana, yaracumbikiraga abashyitsi, yarozaga ibirenge by'abera, yarafashaga abababaye, agashishikarira gukurikiza imirimo myiza yose.

11.text: Ariko abapfakazi bato ntukemere ko bandikwa, kuko iyo bamaze kwidamararira baharika Kristo bakifuza gucyurwa,

12.text: bakagibwaho n'urubanza kuko bavuye mu isezerano ryabo rya mbere.

13.text: Kandi uretse ibyo, biga no kugira ubute, bakagenda imihana; nyamara si abanyabute gusa, ahubwo kandi ni n'abanyamazimwe na ba kazitereyemo, bavuga ibidakwiriye.

14.text: Ni cyo gituma nshaka ko abapfakazi bato bashyingirwa, bakabyara abana, bagategeka ingo zabo, ntibahe abanzi urwitwazo rwo kudutuka;

15.text: kuko n'ubu bamwe bamaze guteshuka inzira, ngo bakurikize Satani.

16.text: Nihagira uwizera w'umugabo cyangwa w'umugore ufite indushyi z'abapfakazi, abafashe, kugira ngo Itorero ritaremererwa, ahubwo ribone uko rifasha abapfakazi nyakuri.

17.text: Abakuru b'Itorero batwara neza batekerezwe ko bakwiriye guhabwa icyubahiro incuro ebyiri, ariko cyane cyane abarushywa no kuvuga ijambo ry'Imana no kwigisha,

18.text: kuko ibyanditswe bivuga ngo “Ntugahambire umunwa w'inka ihonyōra”, kandi ngo “Umukozi akwiriye guhembwa.”

19.text: Ntukemere ikirego ku mukuru hatariho abagabo babiri cyangwa batatu.

20.text: Abakora ibyaha ubahanire mu maso ya bose, kugira ngo abandi na bo batinye.

21.text: Ndakwihanangiririza imbere y'Imana na Yesu Kristo n'abamarayika batoranijwe, kugira ngo witondere ibyo udaca urw'umwe cyangwa ngo ugire ubwo uca urwa kibera.

22.text: Ntukihutire kugira uwo urambikaho ibiganza kandi ntugafatanye n'ibyaha by'abandi, ahubwo wirindire kuba intungane.

23.text: Uhereye none reka kunywa amazi gusa, ahubwo unywe vino nke ku bw'inda yawe kuko urwaragura.

24.text: Ibyaha by'abantu bamwe bigaragara hakiri kare, bikabakururira mu rubanza, naho iby'abandi bizagaragara hanyuma.

25.text: Uko ni ko n'imirimo myiza igaragara hakiri kare, ndetse n'itagaragara na yo ntishobora guhishwa iteka.
